rootCauses.why: The cell state machine at line 100-109 allows QUEUED -> [LOADING, UNLOADED, FAILED] but not QUEUED -> LOADED. A cell is being marked LOADED while it is still QUEUED, so the transition is rejected, the state is never advanced, and the guard warns on every attempt.
rootCauses.fix: Route the cell through LOADING before LOADED, or add LOADED to the QUEUED allowed list if a queued cell can legitimately complete without entering LOADING.
examples: [WorldCellManager] Illegal state transition for CELL_CAU_001: QUEUED -> LOADED

rootCauses.why: MeshLambertMaterial has no roughness property; it belongs to MeshStandardMaterial / MeshPhysicalMaterial. three.js warns once per constructed instance, so the count scales with the number of streamed terrain chunks built.
rootCauses.fix: Use THREE.MeshStandardMaterial with roughness, or drop the roughness key and keep Lambert.
examples: THREE.MeshLambertMaterial: 'roughness' is not a property of this material.

rootCauses.why: The requested authored model does not exist, so the entity is replaced with a procedural silhouette. This is a degraded visual, not a crash, and it is logged rather than hidden.
rootCauses.fix: Author the missing model, or accept the procedural silhouette as the shipped art and remove the expectation of an authored asset from the registry.

rootCauses.why: A registry entry points at a file that is not on disk. The loader logs and continues; the prop is simply absent from the world (it is NOT replaced by a fake mesh).
rootCauses.fix: Author the asset or point the registry entry at an existing model.

rootCauses.why: The runtime validator detected invalid state and repaired it in place instead of throwing.
rootCauses.fix: Inspect the repaired value; a self-heal that fires every session points at an unresolved state bug upstream.

rootCauses.why: Browser storage partitioning applied to the Firebase CDN scripts. Harmless in this run, but it means Firebase storage access can be blocked by privacy settings.
rootCauses.fix: No action required unless Firebase persistence fails for real users.
